title: Textiles - Woven terry towelling fabrics and towels made of man-made fibres and their blends
clause_1_scope: 1.1 This standard specifies the performance requirements for woven terry towelling fabrics and towels made from man-made fibres and their blends used in the manufacture of beach, bath, hand, finger tip and kitchen towels and face cloths. 1.2 It is not applicable to woven terry fabrics used for apparel.
